entities.name: Roberto Soldić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Roberto Soldić is a Croatian mixed martial artist, and professional boxer. He is currently competing in the Welterweight division of ONE Championship. He formerly competed in KSW, where he was the promotion’s two time Welterweight and one time Middleweight champion, holding both the belts until his signing to ONE. He also competed in FFC, where he was the Welterweight Champion, and in Superior FC, where he was also their Welterweight champion.
